notes: First-party Claude API, global routing (no inference_geo). inference_geo 'us' would add a 1.1x multiplier; this app does not set it.
Claude Sonnet 5: the pricing page footnote says $2/$10 is now the standard price; the planned Sept 1, 2026 increase to $3/$15 will not occur.
Cache writes: 5m = 1.25x base input, 1h = 2x base input. Cache reads: 0.1x base input for both models listed here.
Batch API is 50% off input and output (not used yet).

tokenizer_note.text: Pricing page: "Claude 4.7 and later models ... use a newer tokenizer ... approximately 30% more tokens for the same text. Claude Sonnet 4.6 and earlier models use the previous tokenizer." Claude Sonnet 5 is a later model, so it uses the newer tokenizer. Haiku 4.5 is not named on the page; it predates 4.7, so it is marked previous (inferred). Either way this app never estimates tokens from characters: counts come from the API (count_tokens before a call, usage after).
